en.headline: Customs seize HK$10 million in illicit cigarettes from speedboat in southeast waters
en.dek: Officers intercepted a high-powered speedboat without navigation lights off the Ninepin Group early on Tuesday and arrested two mainland men.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected a sea-smuggling case involving a high-powered speedboat in the southeast waters of Hong Kong early on Tuesday and seized about 2.23 million suspected illicit cigarettes with an estimated market value of about HK$10 million.

According to Customs, officers conducting an anti-smuggling operation spotted a suspicious speedboat without navigation lights heading towards the Ninepin Group. The vessel accelerated to flee when officers gave chase.

Officers later boarded and stopped the speedboat, which was fitted with three high-powered outboard engines. Two mainland men aged 32 and 39 were arrested on suspicion of offences under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance. The duty potential of the cigarettes was put at about HK$7.37 million.

Customs said anyone who imports, deals with, possesses, sells or buys duty-not-paid cigarettes commits an offence. Upon conviction the maximum penalty is a fine of HK$2 million and seven years’ imprisonment, or a fine of HK$1 million and two years’ imprisonment depending on the circumstances.

zh.headline: 海關東南水域截大馬力快艇 檢約一千萬元私煙拘兩人
zh.dek: 關員於果洲群島東南對開截停沒有開啟航行燈的快艇，拘捕兩名內地男子，檢獲約223萬支懷疑私煙。
body: 香港海關周二清晨在香港東南面水域偵破一宗利用大馬力快艇走私私煙的案件，檢獲約223萬支懷疑私煙，估計市值約1,000萬元，應課稅值約737萬元。
海關表示，人員在果洲群島東南對開海面發現一艘沒有開啟航行燈的可疑快艇駛向南果洲，上前追截時快艇加速逃走。關員其後成功登上並截停該艇。
快艇配備三個大馬力舷外引擎，船上兩名分別32歲及39歲的內地男子涉嫌違反《應課稅品條例》被捕。海關亦檢取涉案快艇。
根據條例，任何人進口、處理、管有、售賣或購買未完稅香煙即屬違法，一經定罪最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁七年，或罰款100萬元及監禁兩年。
